connector.name: Twiceshy
connector.registryDescription: Experience memory for coding agents: validated traps, fixes and dead-ends at decision time.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.twiceshy.app over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace app.twiceshy, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token from the free alpha signup at https://twiceshy.app (format: Bearer tok_...)
